inventory_reason: Existing engine modules and runtime dependencies at the baseline. Additions need a mission-fit rationale in the PR; this inventory is a review tripwire, not a ban on useful additions. Health measurement queries use chrono/chrono-tz for explicit IANA timezones and DST-safe daily aggregation; a fixed-offset implementation would misgroup measurements. Health remains a grant-scoped deterministic read projection, not coaching or device control. key_control is an internal rebuildable encrypted index for the existing keyring membership/epoch fold; it adds no adapter, service, client surface, dependency, or authority source.
